finding.name: canonical handoff still says exactly one provider entry although exact server deliberately permits bounded planner-correction provider steps
exact_source: handle_openai_responses performs the initial or continuation completion through lease.run(..., retry_operation=initial_completion)
the same handler evaluates planner output in a bounded correction loop and can deliberately call lease.run again for a malformed, unavailable or refusal-style planner recommendation
correction_attempt == 2 is the exhaustion boundary; correction provider steps are intentional product behavior, not transport retries
the same server also contains a separate foreground transport recursion that is an implicit retry and must be suppressed after durable intent
finding.risk: Implementing the literal handoff phrase 'exactly one provider entry' would either delete valid planner-correction behavior or force the durable transaction to end too early. Conversely, leaving correction lease.run calls on default failover would permit an implicit extra provider attempt after durable intent.

corrected_invariant.before_intent: local lease/account acquisition only; provider call count must remain zero
corrected_invariant.after_intent: no implicit provider replay: every deliberate planner step may enter the already-selected provider at most once, with AccountLease failover disabled and the outer foreground transport recursion disabled
corrected_invariant.correction: a valid bounded planner correction is allowed under the same unresolved durable intent and on the same selected lease/account; a transport failure during any deliberate step leaves the intent unresolved and publishes no client result
corrected_invariant.finalize: after the first valid final completion, build one canonical Responses or compaction payload and strictly finalize it before memory cache, reservation or client projection
corrected_invariant.retry_after_success: an exact retry or restart after durable finalize adds zero provider calls and returns the same durable payload/identifiers

acceptance_counter_wording.with: no implicit provider replay; each deliberate planner step is attempted at most once
acceptance_counter_wording.ambiguous_transport_case: provider step count does not increase after the failing deliberate step; there is no sibling failover and no outer transport retry
